quality_observations.finding: GitHub Actions launched the Playwright Chrome project but caught a missing-resource 404 console error before merge.
Branded Chrome launched under the Codex app aborted during macOS application registration and produced visible crash popups; the same headless Chrome channel launched in GitHub Actions.
The final correction worker ended after a post-mutation failure that the factory classified as ambiguous-mutation, so no unproven change was pushed.

crash_evidence.preservation: Original retained in the operator's macOS DiagnosticReports directory; raw host diagnostic metadata is not copied into the repository.

criteria.criterion: A comparison submission for validated illustrative input renders `Short horizon (20 years)`, `Standard horizon (30 years)`, and `Long horizon (40 years)` in that order, and each rendered scenario shows one visible outcome summary plus one year-by-year projection generated from the existing deterministic retirement model and the repository-curated `SECURITIES` set.

In Google Chrome, the representative illustrative run at `$1,000,000` starting portfolio, `$40,000` first-year withdrawal, and `3%` inflation renders the three named horizons and their projection tables in under 1 second and produces no page-generated console errors.

After a valid comparison result is visible, a later invalid submission clears the prior summaries, tables, and money output before the actionable refusal appears, and the visible illustrative / non-advice disclosure remains present.
